# THE-AI-VIDEO-EDITOR

> Programmatic video studio for AI agents: Remotion, HyperFrames (HeyGen), Three.js/R3F, Blender MCP, Higgsfield cinema/VFX, REA reverse engineering. It includes skills, forensic capability atlases for Claude Opus 5.5 / GPT-6.1 Sol / Gemini 4 Argon / Higgsfield / HeyGen / Remotion, and a tested toolkit (`pro-editor-kit/`) that cuts, captions, lints, mixes and QA-checks videos.

## Start here
- [Agent operating loop](pro-editor-kit/START-HERE-FOR-AGENTS.md): brief → transcript → cut → plan → build → lint → render → QA → critic → sound → deliver
